notes: Priority 2 audit fixes, batch 3 (1.11.18, items 2.2-2.6): (2.2) one progress definition — a hero progress bar on the dashboard (% of today's planned time ticked + real timer minutes + remaining, all labelled); day-summary rows labelled (scheduled done vs real time); Overview overall card relabelled to boxes done, so only the hero bar carries the word progress. (2.3) remaining-workload forecast to the nearest exam — remaining tests ÷ days left = tests/day needed, same for the hours of undone boxes linked to the exam budget; verdict on track / behind / impossible against the historical daily rate (last 28 days, active days only); when no test counts were entered it says so instead of a false 0 remaining. (2.4) lagging-subject detection vs programme pace — expected = total boxes × elapsed% of the programme range; subjects with done/expected < 0.8 ranked by hour shortfall, shown in Analytics and in Overview. (2.5) weak-chapter analysis by accuracy — per chapter accuracy = correct ÷ attempted (only where attempted >= 10), ranked by (1 − accuracy) × volume, top 3 with the nearest exam's budget topics they feed; FIRST fixed the §3.3 item-18 recount bug in topicAgg (manual book counts now win over linked box tests instead of summing both — the same tests were counted twice). (2.6) smart backlog-compensation suggestions — each undone past box scored by exam proximity × remaining tests × (1 − accuracy); top 5 get a concrete gap (first future light day, respecting the max-2-parts-of-one-subject-per-day rule and a 12h day cap) with a one-click move button; boxes never move automatically, the move uses the edit-form state.edits path. No 1.1 (localhost auth) — user dismissed it as accepted risk. Known totals unchanged: حسابان 3489, شیمی 3000; گسسته and فیزیک have none (2110 not reintroduced).
